units.source_text: 夜露载道，朝雾弥漫，不辨方向，如入迷途。

en.t: Night dew covered the road, and morning mist spread everywhere; they could not tell the direction, as if they had wandered into a maze.

units.source_text: 源氏公子一面行路，一面想象那和生前一样躺着的姿态、

en.t: As Prince Genji traveled on, he kept imagining her lying there just as she had in life,

units.source_text: 那天晚上交换给她的那件红衣盖在遗骸上的样子，

en.t: and the red robe he had exchanged with her that night spread over her remains.

units.source_text: 觉得这真是何等奇特的宿缘！

en.t: He felt that this was a strangely fated bond indeed.

units.source_text: 他无力乘马，摇摇欲坠，全赖惟光在旁扶持，

en.t: He had no strength to ride and was on the verge of falling, relying entirely on Koremitsu to support him at his side.

units.source_text: 百般鼓励，方能前进。

en.t: Only after repeated encouragement could he move forward.

units.source_text: 走到贺茂川堤上，竟从马上滑了下来。

en.t: When they reached the embankment of the Kamo River, he actually slipped down from the horse.

units.source_text: 心情十分恶劣，叹道：“

en.t: Feeling terribly ill, he sighed and said, "

units.source_text: 我将倒毙在这路上了吧？

en.t: Am I going to collapse and die on this road?

units.source_text: 看来回不得家了！”

en.t: It seems I will not be able to return home!"

units.source_text: 惟光不知如何是好，心中想道：“

en.t: Koremitsu did not know what to do and thought to himself, "

units.source_text: 我要是主意坚决，

en.t: If only I had been firmer in my resolve,

units.source_text: 即使他命令我，我也决不会带他来走这条路，

en.t: even if he had ordered me, I never would have brought him along this road,

units.source_text: 但现已后悔莫及。”

en.t: but now it is too late for regret."

units.source_text: 狼狈之极，只得用贺茂川水把两手洗洗干净，

en.t: In utter distress, he could only wash both hands clean with water from the Kamo River,

units.source_text: 合掌祈求观音菩萨保佑，

en.t: join his palms, and pray for the protection of the Bodhisattva Kannon.

units.source_text: 此外毫无办法。

en.t: There was absolutely nothing else he could do.

units.source_text: 源氏公子自己也勉强振作起来，

en.t: Prince Genji himself also forced himself to rally his spirits,

units.source_text: 在心中念佛祈愿，

en.t: silently invoked the Buddha and prayed in his heart,

units.source_text: 再靠惟光帮助，好容易回到了二条院。

en.t: and with Koremitsu's help, at last managed to return to the Nijo residence.
